ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the
C2-1, Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District symbols and indications as
shown on Map No. 24-F in the area bound by:

the alley next north of and parallel to West 103" Street; South Normal
Avenue; West 103" Street and a line 72 feet west of and parallel to South
Normal Avenue,

to those of a RS-2, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Biff CL Boab.

Anthony Beale
Alderman, 9* Ward

Common Address:
500-508 West 103" Street
